newsitem.title: ITALY: CYCLING-CIPOLLINI CLAIMS THIRD WIN IN FOUR DAYS.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-CIPOLLINI CLAIMS THIRD WIN IN FOUR DAYS.

text.p: Italy's Mario Cipollini claimed his third stage victory in the first four days of the Giro d'Italia cycle race on Tuesday.
A day after losing the pink jersey of Giro leader to Russian Pavel Tonkov, the Tuscan bounced back for his 19th Giro stage success.
Compatriot Endrio Leoni was second and Spain's Angel Edo third in a mass finish to the 156-km race from San Marino.
A late bid for victory by Italy's Gabriele Colombo ended in a crash in the streets of Arezzo.
As he swung into a bend, with the chasing field closing, his bike slipped from under him, sending the 1996 winner of the Milan-San Remo classic sliding into the gutter.
Tonkov retained the overall race lead, one second ahead of fellow Russian Yevgeny Berzin.
